cond_0001.intro: The Extrusion Engineer shall utilize engineering principles, processes, and methods to produce products that meet our customer's requirements in a cost-effective manner. This position will resolve technical problems specifically related to thermoplastic extrusion in support of both manufacturing and new product development. Additionally, the Extrusion Engineer will develop, implement, maintain, and improve processes that are capable and in control with the application of statistical tools.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Support thermoplastic extrusion process to meet on time delivery and quality standards.
Perform required calculations and selection of tooling (tips, dies, screws, etc.) for specific applications.
Create, modify, and maintain thermoplastic extrusion manufacturing procedures and setup sheets.
Troubleshoot extrusion process issues.
Provide training on thermoplastic processes/procedures/equipment to manufacturing personnel.
Develop, improve, and maintain preventative maintenance requirements for thermoplastic extrusion equipment.
Collect and analyze data to reduce process/product variation.
Evaluate new raw materials, additives, colorants, etc. For extruded cable jackets.
Recommend purchase of new and/or specialized equipment in support of continuous process improvements and new product development.
Support Process Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) for thermoplastic extrusion processes.
Support corrective action implementation for customer returns.
Direct Engineering Technicians for successful completion of assigned projects.
Obey safety rules and promote plant safety initiatives.
Other duties as required in support of the department and the company.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum 5 years of engineering experience with wire and cable extrusion.
Ability to read, write, speak and understand English.
Proficient written and verbal communication skills.
Preferred Requirements
B.S. In Engineering.

cond_0072.intro: We are looking for an Extrusion Engineer to join our team. Working alongside manufacturing and product development teams, you will apply engineering principles and statistical tools to help produce products that meet customer requirements in a cost-effective way. A key part of the role is supporting the resolution of technical problems related to thermoplastic extrusion and helping to develop, implement, and maintain capable, controlled processes.
cond_0072.responsibilities:
Support the thermoplastic extrusion process to help meet on-time delivery and quality standards.
Work with relevant teams to perform required calculations and select tooling (tips, dies, screws, etc.) for specific applications.
Create, modify, and maintain thermoplastic extrusion manufacturing procedures and setup sheets in coordination with the team.
Help troubleshoot extrusion process issues alongside manufacturing personnel.
Provide training on thermoplastic processes, procedures, and equipment to manufacturing personnel.
Coordinate with maintenance teams to develop, improve, and maintain preventative maintenance requirements for thermoplastic extrusion equipment.
Collect and analyze data together with the team to reduce process and product variation.
Work with materials teams to evaluate new raw materials, additives, colorants, etc. For extruded cable jackets.
Share recommendations for the purchase of new or specialized equipment in support of continuous process improvements and new product development.
Support Process Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) for thermoplastic extrusion processes.
Assist with corrective action implementation for customer returns.
Coordinate with Engineering Technicians to ensure successful completion of assigned projects.
Follow safety rules and support plant safety initiatives.
Other duties as required in support of the department and the company.
cond_0072.requirements:
B.S. In Engineering preferred.
Minimum 5 years of engineering experience with wire and cable extrusion required.
Ability to read, write, speak, and understand English.
Proficient written and verbal communication skills.
This position includes access or potential access to ITAR and/or EAR technical data. Candidates will need to qualify as a US Person, defined as a US Citizen or a Permanent Resident (Green Card Holder).
Travel: 0-5%.
No certificates, licenses, or registrations required.
Physical requirements: regularly required to use hands to finger, handle or feel, and talk or hear. Frequently required to reach with hands and arms. Required to stand and walk. Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
Personal Protective Equipment requirements in specific areas: ASTM F-2412-2005, ANSI Z41-1999, or ANSI Z41-1991 rated safety toe shoes; clear ANSI Z87.1 safety rated glasses; hearing protection; ability to comply with JSA.

cond_0150.intro: The Extrusion Engineer will use engineering principles, processes, and methods to produce products that meet customer requirements in a cost-effective way. This position involves resolving technical problems related to thermoplastic extrusion in support of both manufacturing and new product development. You will regularly connect with manufacturing personnel, engineering technicians, and cross-functional teams to keep processes running well. The Extrusion Engineer will also develop, implement, maintain, and improve processes that are capable and in control using statistical tools.
cond_0150.responsibilities:
Support thermoplastic extrusion process to meet on time delivery and quality standards.
Perform required calculations and selection of tooling (tips, dies, screws, etc.) for specific applications.
Create, modify, and maintain thermoplastic extrusion manufacturing procedures and setup sheets.
Troubleshoot extrusion process issues, initiating contact with relevant teams early to resolve problems quickly.
Provide hands-on training on thermoplastic processes, procedures, and equipment to manufacturing personnel on a regular basis.
Develop, improve, and maintain preventative maintenance requirements for thermoplastic extrusion equipment.
Collect and analyze data to reduce process and product variation, and communicate findings clearly to stakeholders.
Evaluate new raw materials, additives, colorants, etc. For extruded cable jackets.
Recommend purchase of new and/or specialized equipment in support of continuous process improvements and new product development.
Support Process Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) for thermoplastic extrusion processes.
Support corrective action implementation for customer returns, working closely with the relevant teams to clarify requirements and walk through solutions.
Direct Engineering Technicians for successful completion of assigned projects.
Obey safety rules and promote plant safety initiatives.
Other duties as required in support of the department and the company.
cond_0150.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum 5 years of engineering experience with wire and cable extrusion.
Ability to read, write, speak, and understand English.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including comfort explaining technical issues and walking colleagues through process decisions.
Preferred Requirements
B.S. In Engineering.

Additionally, the Extrusion Engineer will develop, implement, maintain, and improve processes that are capable and in control with the application of statistical tools. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of thermoplastic extrusion processes and how they connect to product quality.
cond_0175.responsibilities:
Support thermoplastic extrusion process to meet on time delivery and quality standards.
Perform required calculations and selection of tooling (tips, dies, screws, etc.) for specific applications.
Create, modify, and maintain thermoplastic extrusion manufacturing procedures and setup sheets.
Troubleshoot extrusion process issues.
Provide training on thermoplastic processes/procedures/equipment to manufacturing personnel.
Develop, improve, and maintain preventative maintenance requirements for thermoplastic extrusion equipment.
Collect and analyze data to reduce process/product variation.
Evaluate new raw materials, additives, colorants, etc. For extruded cable jackets.
Recommend purchase of new and/or specialized equipment in support of continuous process improvements and new product development.
Support Process Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) for thermoplastic extrusion processes.
Support corrective action implementation for customer returns.
Direct Engineering Technicians for successful completion of assigned projects.
Obey safety rules and promote plant safety initiatives.
Other duties as required in support of the department and the company.
cond_0175.requirements:
B.S. In Engineering preferred. Minimum 5 years of engineering experience with wire and cable extrusion required. Ability to read, write, speak and understand English. Proficient written and verbal communication skills.

The Extrusion Engineer will also develop, implement, maintain, and improve processes that are capable and in control through the application of statistical tools.
cond_0188.responsibilities:
Drive thermoplastic extrusion process performance to meet on-time delivery and quality standards.
Execute required calculations and selection of tooling (tips, dies, screws, etc.) for specific applications.
Create, modify, and maintain thermoplastic extrusion manufacturing procedures and setup sheets.
Lead troubleshooting of extrusion process issues.
Deliver training on thermoplastic processes, procedures, and equipment to manufacturing personnel.
Develop, improve, and maintain preventative maintenance requirements for thermoplastic extrusion equipment.
Collect and analyze data to reduce process and product variation.
Evaluate new raw materials, additives, colorants, etc. For extruded cable jackets.
Determine and recommend purchase of new and/or specialized equipment in support of continuous process improvements and new product development.
Own support of Process Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) for thermoplastic extrusion processes.
Drive corrective action implementation for customer returns.
Direct Engineering Technicians to ensure successful completion of assigned projects.
Enforce safety rules and champion plant safety initiatives.
Other duties as required in support of the department and the company.
cond_0188.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum 5 years of engineering experience with wire and cable extrusion
Ability to read, write, speak, and understand English
Proficient written and verbal communication skills
This position includes access or potential access to ITAR and/or EAR technical data; candidates must qualify as a US Person (US Citizen or Permanent Resident/Green Card Holder)
Ability to meet physical demands: regular use of hands, reaching, standing, walking, and occasionally lifting/moving up to 25 pounds
Ability to comply with PPE requirements including safety toe shoes (ASTM F-2412-2005, ANSI Z41-1999, or ANSI Z41-1991), ANSI Z87.1 safety glasses, hearing protection, and JSA compliance in specific areas
Preferred Requirements
B.S. In Engineering

cond_0253.intro: The Extrusion Engineer shall utilize engineering principles, processes, and methods to produce products that meet our customer's requirements in a cost-effective manner. This position will resolve technical problems specifically related to thermoplastic extrusion in support of both manufacturing and new product development. Additionally, the Extrusion Engineer will develop, implement, maintain, and improve processes that are capable and in control with the application of statistical tools.
cond_0253.responsibilities:
Support thermoplastic extrusion process to meet on time delivery and quality standards.
Perform required calculations and selection of tooling (tips, dies, screws, etc.) for specific applications.
Create, modify, and maintain thermoplastic extrusion manufacturing procedures and setup sheets.
Troubleshoot extrusion process issues.
Provide training on thermoplastic processes/procedures/equipment to manufacturing personnel.
Develop, improve, and maintain preventative maintenance requirements for thermoplastic extrusion equipment.
Collect and analyze data to reduce process/product variation.
Evaluate new raw materials, additives, colorants, etc. For extruded cable jackets.
Recommend purchase of new and/or specialized equipment in support of continuous process improvements and new product development.
Support Process Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (PFMEA) for thermoplastic extrusion processes.
Support corrective action implementation for customer returns.
Direct Engineering Technicians for successful completion of assigned projects.
Obey safety rules and promote plant safety initiatives.
Other duties as required in support of the department and the company.
cond_0253.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Minimum 5 years of engineering experience with wire and cable extrusion.
Ability to read, write, speak and understand English.
Proficient written and verbal communication skills.
Preferred Requirements
B.S. In Engineering.
